identity.fantasy: Come alive as a moonlit museum statue, dance between patrols, and freeze before the friendly night guard's flashlight can catch you.
identity.playerVerb: Dance freely, then hold a dramatic whole-body statue pose while the flashlight searches the gallery.
identity.targetMetaphor: Five gallery stars restored by surviving three increasingly precise golden patrols.

beats.purpose: Learn the light-and-shadow rhythm with one forgiving freeze under the first blue patrol.
Link two longer statue holds while dancing through the moonlit middle gallery.
Resolve the exhibition with two precise golden-patrol poses and the masterpiece chime.

themedEntities: marble living-statue costume and laurel crown
pose-seeking guard flashlight and five exhibition plinths
reactiveStates: flashlight searching while the player must freeze
gold hold ring filling around a masterful statue pose
presenter.continuousFeedback: The flashlight tracks the pose center, the hold ring fills continuously, the marble costume follows local landmarks, and five persistent plinth stars record every successful freeze.
presenter.scoreAndResolution: A persistent bilingual five-star exhibition score spans three escalating patrol beats, then resolves in a dedicated Museum Masterpiece panel and original victory chime.
